dominated_option_pruning.rule: Drop option B only when another option A in the same cell has A.bytes <= B.bytes and A.cost[class] <= B.cost[class] for every one of the six constrained classes, with at least one strict inequality.

greedy_feasible_seed.acceptance: atomic pair only: one freeing sell plus one spending buy; combined package bytes <= envelope; every class remains nonnegative and <= its hard ceiling, including CODE <= 0.0501789538560735; combined reweighted objective strictly improves
greedy_feasible_seed.candidate_order: deterministic sell+buy pair ranking under the reweighted objective; no single move may be committed
greedy_feasible_seed.fallback: If no admissible improving pair exists, retain the legal prior V2 assignment as the SCIP hint; do not weaken any cap or alter prices.
greedy_feasible_seed.start: legal prior V2 terminal assignment on the identical current menu and corrected-grid surface

hard_code_guard.p887_interpretation: late-layer concentration not confirmed; do not invent layer-band prices
hard_code_guard.rationale: The current sealed incumbent is exactly feasible and supplies a preregistered no-code-regression cap on the same measured-price surface. This cap does not alter the uniform-six objective; it only rejects assignments whose aggregate predicted code KLD exceeds the incumbent.

mandatory_purchase_table_schema.bytes_by_tier: for QTIP2/QTIP3/QTIP15: selected logical bytes, gross bytes freed, gross bytes spent, net byte delta
mandatory_purchase_table_schema.changed_cells: integer plus full rows: layer, expert, projection, from, to, delta_bytes, delta_by_class
mandatory_purchase_table_schema.hard_code_guard: cap, observed code prediction, slack, PASS/FAIL
mandatory_purchase_table_schema.objective_reweighted: finite nonnegative normalized weighted mean using the preregistered class weights

objective: normalized class-weighted mean with multilingual protection and code moat
